questions.q_en: Find the product of all the prime numbers between 70 and 80.

questions.solution_en:
P and Q can be 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17 or 19.

I: If we take Q = 2, then the value of 2P + 3Q will be even.

II: For maximum value, the value of (P+Q) is maximum and (P - Q) is minimum.

Let P = 19 and Q = 17

(17 + 19)/(19 - 17) = 18

So, option 'd' is correct.

questions.q_en: The sum of square of two positive numbers is 808 and cube of one number is 2904 more than the square of its 4 times, then find the second number?
questions.solution_en:
Let two numbers be A and B.

A2 + B2 = 808

And A3 = 2904 + (4A)2

=> A3 - 16A2 = 2904

=> A2(A - 16) = 484 * 6 = 222 * (22 - 16)

So, A = 22

So, B2 = 808 - 222 = 324

=> B = 18

questions.q_en: There are two numbers X and Y such that X is equal to the sum of all prime numbers between 118 and 140 and Y is equal to the sum of composite numbers from 61 to 97, then what is the difference between X and Y?
questions.solution_en:
All prime numbers between 118 and 140 = {127, 131, 137, 139}

Sum = 127 + 131 + 137 + 139 = 534

Sum of all natural-numbers from 61 to 97 = (97 - 61 + 1)/2 * (61 + 97) = 2923

And all prime numbers from 61 to 97 = {61, 67, 71, 73, 79, 83, 89, 97}

Sum = 61 + 67 + 71 + 73 + 79 + 83 + 89 + 97 = 620

So, sum of all composite numbers from 61 to 97 = 2923 - 620 = 2303

So, required difference = 2303 - 534 = 1769

questions.q_en: x, y, and z are distinct prime numbers where x < y < z. If xy + yz = 154, then what is the sum of possible values of z?
questions.solution_en:
xy + yz = 154

=> y(x + z) = 7 * 22

Since, y < z. So, y < (x + z)

Thus, y = 7 and x + z = 22

Now, putting x = 2, and z = 20 (not possible)

Again, putting x = 3, and z = 19 (possible)

Again, putting x = 5, and z = 17 (possible)

Again, putting x = 7, and z = 15 (not possible)

Again, putting x = 11, and z = 11 (not possible)

Hence, sum of possible values of z = 19 + 17 = 36

questions.q_en:
Which of the following statement is true?

I. 167+116 is odd

II. 155-124 is even
questions.solution_en:
I. 167+116

When an even number is multiplied by another even number then their solution will be even. So,

167will be even.

Similarly, when an odd number is multiplied by another odd number then their solution will be odd. So, 116 will be odd.

Sum of an even number and an odd number always gives an odd value.

So, 167+116 is odd.

Hence, statement I is true.

II. 155-124

When an odd number is multiplied by another odd number then their solution will be odd. So,

155 will be odd.

Similarly, when an even number is multiplied by another even number then their solution will be even. So, 124will be even.

Difference between an even number and an odd number always gives an odd value.

So, 155-124 is odd.

Hence, statement II is wrong.

questions.q_en: How many balls Aman has if Ana has 436 balls, which is 112 more than thrice the number of balls Aman has?
questions.solution_en:
It is given that,

Ana has 436 balls.

436 = 112 + 3 x Aman

436 - 112 = 3 x Aman

324 = 3 x Aman

324/3 = Aman

Aman = 108.

Hence, Aman has 108 balls.

questions.q_en: Three positive numbers A, B, and C are co-prime to each other. If product of A and B is 399 and product of B and C is 840 then, the value of A + B - C is:
questions.solution_en:
A * B = 399

B * C = 840

(A * B)/ (B * C) = 399/840

A/C = 19/40

Since A, B, and C are co - prime so, A = 19 and C = 40

And B = 21

Now, value of A + B - C = 19 + 21 - 40 = 40 - 40 = 0

questions.q_en: How many times digit '6' appears in numbers which are perfect square from 2 to 300?
questions.solution_en:
Perfect squares from 2 to 300 in which 6 appears are:

16, 36, 64, 169, 196, 256

Hence, 6 appears 6 times in perfect squares from 2 to 300.
